description: This plot illustrates the search space of M-Cube by displaying the number of possible solutions in relation to the number of missing pieces for two conditions. The linear x-axis is labeled "# Missing pieces", ranges from 1 to 6, and has a tick mark interval of 1. The logarithmic y-axis is labeled "# Possible solutions" and displays a range from below 10^2 to 10^8 with tick marks at 10^2, 10^4, 10^6, and 10^8. The "Flip needed" condition is represented by a thick, solid orange line with circular markers that demonstrates a steady increase across the x-axis, starting at a value below 10^2 at 1 missing piece and reaching exactly 10^8 at 6 missing pieces, where the marker is enclosed in a red circle adjacent to the red text "CUBE". The "Flip ignored" condition is depicted by a thick, solid light blue line with circular markers that similarly exhibits a steady upward trend, beginning at a value below 10^2 at 1 missing piece and concluding at a value between 10^6 and 10^8 at 6 missing pieces; its marker at 2 missing pieces is enclosed in a red circle and accompanied by the red text "CUBE-easy".
